daemon.description: [experimental] Declare a daemon running a command, ready once its port accepts connections

daemonPreset.description: [experimental] Declare a database or a message broker from a mise service preset, at a major version

daemonTask.description: [experimental] Declare a daemon running a mise task

daemonAuto.description: [experimental] Declare a daemon that starts when entering the project, and stops once the last shell left

daemonGroups.description: [experimental] Name sets of daemons, such as the default group `mise daemons start` starts
